subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes change from disabled to a default periodic fallback for existing users?
rationale: The source-level bug is real, but the most direct fix changes default background work and fallback behavior, which AGENTS.md treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept a scoped default-on fallback
options.body: Merge a reviewed fix that defaults the interval fallback on, preserves explicit intervalMinutes: 0, and marks dirty only for memory-source managers.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Leave the default at 0 and resolve this issue through docs, doctor guidance, or an explicit setup recommendation for affected users.

options.title: Use a narrower health-check design
options.body: Avoid changing the default interval and instead add watcher liveness diagnostics or warning-only recovery first.

recommendation.title: Accept a scoped default-on fallback
recommendation.body: Merge a reviewed fix that defaults the interval fallback on, preserves explicit intervalMinutes: 0, and marks dirty only for memory-source managers.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a default/config compatibility decision on a core memory feature, and Peter's history covers both the memory feature and product direction surface.
